note: Re-judged 2026-11-24 (independent reader) against RFC 9252 Section 2. Tested: "Any received Sub-TLVs and Sub-Sub-TLVs that are unrecognized MUST be removed." Gap: "SHOULD be updated with the locally allocated SRv6 SID information." Producer: internal/component/bgp/reactor/forward_prefix_sid.go::applyEgressPrefixSIDNextHop (and prefixSIDNextHopHandler). On both cached and RS forward rails, applyEgressPrefixSIDNextHop compares the original received next-hop entity with the final effective emitted entity (after policy, configured rewrite, and scope normalization) and emits AttrModRemove for SRv6 Service TLV types 5 and 6 when changed; prefixSIDNextHopHandler removes those Service TLVs (and all their nested unrecognized Sub-TLVs 0xF0 and Sub-Sub-TLVs 0xEE) while retaining unrelated top-level TLVs (Label-Index, unknown TLV 200, SRGB) and dropping attribute 40 when no TLV remains. TestRFC9252EffectiveNextHopControlsServiceTLVs (strengthened with NextHopAuto connected-endpoint rewriting and self-equality/restoration controls), TestPrefixSIDPropagationNextHop, and TestRFC9252ServiceOnlyPrefixSIDDroppedOnANextHopChange verify removal on effective A-to-B changes (positive) and preservation on unchanged / effective A-to-A cases (negative) in actual recipient Session output, with all 5 discrimination records freshly recorded. Because Ze still allocates no local SRv6 SID information to rebuild the Service TLVs on next-hop change, the Gap stands. Verdict remains partial.
